subject: Rescheduling: production pilot demo — exec roadshow & FY budgeting
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia@commerceinc.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 01 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot demo next week — confirm availability

Hi Olivia,

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation, we lined up a 60-minute production pilot walkthrough to show the end-to-end latency and cost profile on your exact workload. Proposed slot: Tuesday 12 May, 10:00–11:00 PT. The plan is: 10 min intros, 25 min live demo with your sample prompts, 15 min Q&A, 10 min procurement/next-steps.

I attached the tailored slides and the draft SOW for procurement to review in advance. If that date doesn't work, please suggest two alternatives. We want to align this with your PO timing so we don’t demo too early and then get paused by finance.

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber | Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
From: Olivia Chen <olivia@commerceinc.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procure@commerceinc.com>
Date: Fri, 01 May 2026 13:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot demo next week — confirm availability

Jonas —

Appreciate the readout and the materials. Quick heads up: our CFO will be on a regional roadshow from 11–18 May and we’re entering the FY rebaseline week at the same time. That means our procurement and finance teams are freezing spend decisions until the reset lands (likely mid-June).

Given that, we’d prefer to pause live production demos until we have clearer guidance from finance — otherwise the demo risks being deferred again and wasting both teams’ time. Can we tentatively hold a spot the week of 22 Jun and I’ll confirm as soon as I have the green light? My procurement lead copied here can help with PO timing.

Best,
Olivia
Olivia Chen | Senior Product Manager | Commerce Inc.
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia@commerceinc.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 04 May 2026 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot demo next week — confirm availability

Olivia — thanks for the heads up and for looping procurement. Totally understand — we don’t want to force timing that will lead to a second postponement.

Laura / Rishi — FYI, Commerce Inc. is entering a rebaseline window and the CFO is traveling 11–18 May. Olivia suggests tentatively moving the hands-on production demo to the week of 22 June. Procurement will still want the SOW and a PO cadence so we don’t lose momentum.

Options I’d propose (pick one):
- Option A: Soft hold for 22–26 Jun (preferred) 
- Option B: Keep a short 30-min technical sync the week of 18 May (no production run) to keep engineers aligned, then full demo in June
- Option C: Pause entirely until procurement confirms PO timing (we’ll follow up in three weeks)

I attached the SOW again; Laura, can you advise whether our standard PO/credit process could speed Commerce’s approval once finance unfreezes? Rishi, can you prepare a short 30-min light demo script if they pick Option B?

Thanks — trying to avoid a scenario where we demo and then can’t close because finance froze spend.

Jonas
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Olivia Chen <olivia@commerceinc.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 04 May 2026 11:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot demo next week — confirm availability

Jonas / Olivia —

We can support a soft hold for the week of 22 June. From the procurement side, two suggestions to keep the deal warm without committing full spend before finance completes the rebaseline:

- Execute a short non-binding SOW (statement of work) for the pilot environment that documents scope but does not trigger invoicing until PO issuance; we can mark the SOW as contingent on PO.
- Offer a free 30-minute technical deep-dive in mid-May (Option B) aimed at the engineering stakeholders — no production data required — to preserve momentum.

If Commerce agrees, Rishi and I can drop an adjusted SOW (contingent clause + dates) and a lightweight tech script for the mid-May sync. Olivia, if you can share tentative preferred windows in the 22–26 Jun week we’ll reserve the engineers.

Laura
Laura Bennett | Sr. Solutions Ops | Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia@commerceinc.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 04 May 2026 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot demo next week — confirm availability

Olivia — understood. If Commerce wants to lock a target week, we’ll tentatively reserve Tues 23 Jun 10:00–11:00 PT for the full pilot and keep Wed 13 May 09:00–09:30 PT as the optional short tech sync (no production run). I’ll prepare a pared-down script for the mid-May session and an updated contingent SOW to accompany Laura’s note.

Next steps:
- Olivia: confirm whether 23 Jun is acceptable as a tentative hold and whether procurement wants the contingent SOW template.
- Commerce Procurement: if you prefer a quick review call for the SOW text, propose two times next week.

Thanks — we’ll keep this on hold and re-open when finance signals.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra | Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
